name: Stale Bread
description: A hard, dry loaf that's seen better days. Not pleasant to eat, but it'll keep hunger at bay.

name: Dried Meat
description: Strips of salted, sun-dried meat. Tough to chew but rich in protein. A staple of travelers and soldiers.

name: Apple
description: A slightly bruised but still edible apple. Sweet and refreshing.

name: Hardtack
description: A dense, unleavened biscuit that could double as a throwing weapon. Lasts forever. Tastes like it too.

name: Hot Stew
description: A bowl of hearty stew with vegetables and a mystery meat. Whatever it is, it's warm and filling.

name: Roasted Chicken
description: A whole roasted chicken, seasoned with herbs and cooked to a golden crisp. The smell alone restores morale.

name: Venison
description: A thick cut of fresh venison, lightly salted and pan-seared. The meal of hunters and lords alike.

name: Cheese Wedge
description: A generous wedge of aged hard cheese. Sharp and salty, best paired with bread — not that you have any.

name: Feast Bread
description: A rich, soft loaf baked with butter and honey. The kind served at noble tables. You must have stolen it.

name: Hearty Broth
description: A thick, restorative broth boiled from prime cuts and rare herbs. Warmth spreads through you with every sip.

name: Smoked Salmon
description: A beautifully smoked side of salmon, caught from a clean northern river. Rich, fatty, and deeply satisfying.
